valētūdinārium, valētūdināriī n.

noun, second declension

Lewis & Short has the adjective valētūdinārius; the neuter noun is in Celsus, Seneca and Tacitus.

Examples

  • Hīc est valētūdinārium, ubi aegrōtī cūrantur.

    This is the hospital, where sick people are looked after.composed

Other words

  • nosocomīum, nosocomīī n.

    noun, second declension · also used · late Latin · M-O s.v. hospital; Cod. Just.

    Lewis & Short gives it with long ī (Greek νοσοκομεῖον).

See also doctor, nurse, pharmacy, doctor’s surgery, ambulance.
